title: Ask the right question

public.goal: Write a prompt that handles incoming requests to the Lumen content team. If a request is missing something essential, ask exactly one clarifying question — the one that actually unblocks the work. If the request is already answerable, just answer it. Never do both.
public.exampleInput: Can you write a welcome email for new users?
